_comment: Interstitial ads after a game ends (docs/release.md 'Ads (AdMob)'). use_real_ads=false shows Google's test ads; it must match is_real in addons/AdmobPlugin/android_export.cfg. Unit id from AdMob > Apps > Ad units. Not secret. An ad is due only after level 10, when leaving a win or lose panel, and only when both min_rounds_between eligible rounds and min_seconds_between have passed.
